memory_candidates.content: On ℤ-time the L⁺ formula φ S ⊥ is exactly "φ at t−1" (yest_iff): the snce clause forces the witness to t−1 because "strictly between" is empty. (q S ⊥) → ⊡(q S ⊥) with the singleton valuation |q| = {τ(t−1)} therefore forces backward determinism on regular ℤ-frames (Probe807Forcing.valid_iff_stepBwdDet), while Pq → ⊡Pq does not (backward cycles). On dense time q S ⊥ is unsatisfiable, so this is ℤ-specific and consistent with deterministic_not_plusDefinable.
